# opstracer_org_member (Resource)

Role and title of an existing org member. Creating it adopts the member (people join through `opstracer_org_invitation`); destroying it only drops it from state and never removes the member from the org.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opstracer_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

# Adopts an existing member. Destroying this only stops managing the member.
resource "opstracer_org_member" "alice" {
  user_id  = data.opstracer_user.alice.id
  role     = "ADMIN"
  title_id = opstracer_member_title.sre.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) User ID of the member, e.g. from the `opstracer_user` data source.

### Optional

- `role` (String) Org role: `OWNER`, `ADMIN` or `MEMBER`. Left as it is when unset.
- `title_id` (String) Member title ID, built-in or from `opstracer_member_title`. Unset means no title.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Member display name.
- `email` (String) Member email.
- `id` (String) Same as `user_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opstracer_org_member.alice <user-id>
```
